app.commerce-product.title: Commerce Product
app.commerce-product.state.empty: Select a product to see everything about it in one place.
app.commerce-product.product.overlayUpda: Content updated {time}{hasUser, select, yes { by {user}} other {}}
app.commerce-product.overview.hint: These base fields are owned by Shopify. Edit them and press “Save to Shopify” to write via the Admin API; the mirror follows via webhook.
app.commerce-product.overview.title: Title
app.commerce-product.hint.adminApiOff: The Shopify Admin API is disabled (see Commerce settings) — Shopify-side edits are unavailable.
app.commerce-product.variants.hint: Price and stock are Shopify-owned: Apply writes to Shopify (Admin API) and the mirror follows via webhook — nothing is edited locally.
app.commerce-product.variants.empty: No inventory breakdown available for this product.
app.commerce-product.variants.noLocation: No per-location inventory levels for this variant.
app.commerce-product.metafields.hint: CMS-authored metafields. Save first, then push to Shopify (requires the Admin API).
app.commerce-product.metafields.pushTitl: Push the saved metafields to Shopify
app.commerce-product.media.hint: Product images in Shopify. Each change (add / delete / reorder / alt text) writes to Shopify (Admin API); the mirror follows via webhook. Add and reorder are processed asynchronously — the list refreshes shortly after.
app.commerce-product.media.empty: This product has no media yet.
app.commerce-product.planning.hint: The fixed per-variant reorder threshold (a unit count): when stock drops at or below it, the "Stock Check + Reorder" task opens. Empty falls back to the planning.yml default (shown as placeholder).
app.commerce-product.planning.footnote: The system never changes this value by itself — the operator sets the fixed threshold; Save persists it.
app.commerce-product.confirm.priceMsg: Set the price of "{title}" to {price} in Shopify?

app.commerce-product.confirm.mediaAddMsg: Add this image to the product in Shopify?
app.commerce-product.confirm.discardBase: You have unsaved Shopify base-field edits that were not sent. Discard them?
app.commerce-product.confirm.mediaDelete: Delete this image from the product in Shopify?
app.commerce-product.confirm.mediaAltMsg: Update this image's alt text in Shopify?

app.commerce-product.status.mediaProcess: Sent to Shopify — processing. Refreshing shortly…
app.commerce-product.status.mediaReorder: Reorder sent to Shopify. The mirror follows via webhook.
app.commerce-product.status.mediaDeleted: Media deleted. The mirror follows via webhook.
app.commerce-product.status.mediaAltAppl: Alt text sent to Shopify. The mirror follows via webhook.
